title: Analysis of fracture pattern in supracondylar humerus fractures in relation to bone density
summary: Based on the retrospective data, the aim of our study is to analyze the relationship between decreased bone density and fracture morphology at the distal humerus and in this way generate important implications for the osteosynthetic treatment of these fractures.
conditions: Fracture of lower end of humerus

interventions.name: Retrospective analysis of patients with supracondylar humerus fracture.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Age over 18 years
- CT examination of the right/left elbow joint in case of supracondylar humerus fracture
- DXA examination (lumbar spine and left/right femur)
Exclusion criteria:
- Age under 18 years
- Incomplete examination data or suboptimal image quality
- Condition after previous surgery on the elbow joint, especially after previous osteosyntheses of the affected upper extremity
- Condition after previous surgery of the lumbar spine and/or both femora
